pixelSizePolicy.nextStep: Before stage 09 reconcile original dimensions and image/world mapping using the existing model; do not report requested size as actual size.
pixelSizePolicy.smallAspectMismatch: If aspect ratio differs by at most 1%, place original image at the requested world rectangle and record scaleX=requestedWidth/actualWidth and scaleY=requestedHeight/actualHeight; no asset resampling or pixel-file overwrite is needed.
pixelSizePolicy.largeAspectMismatch: If aspect ratio differs by more than 1%, use uniform placement scale and revise world/dry masks/positions; rederive exit/arrival bands using min(128,axisSize*0.2), then validate. Coordinator must confirm the revised geometry before stage 09.
